scope: Read-only race and keyboard tests; fresh isolated fixtures with deliberately delayed responses

checks.name: delayed item search cannot overwrite a different dataset
changing the query subject invalidates an in-flight relationship result
closing a graph while data is loading does not render into a disposed view
skip link focuses the current page without changing the route
mobile keeps both exports accessible and supplier selection controls within the viewport
unapplied invalid filters do not break workspace refresh; navigation returns to the top
visual refinements keep tab markers, sticky controls and reduced motion working
